tasks.title: Project Setup and Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with Next.js frontend and Node.js/Express backend, configure TypeScript, and set up the development environment.
tasks.details:
1. Create a monorepo structure with separate directories for frontend and backend
2. Initialize Next.js frontend with TypeScript:
   ```bash
   npx create-next-app@latest frontend --typescript
   ```
3. Initialize Node.js/Express backend with TypeScript:
   ```bash
   mkdir backend
   cd backend
   npm init -y
   npm install express typescript ts-node @types/node @types/express
   npx tsc --init
   ```
4. Configure tsconfig.json for both frontend and backend
5. Set up ESLint and Prettier for code quality
6. Create basic folder structure for both projects
7. Configure environment variables (.env files)
8. Set up Git repository with .gitignore
9. Create README.md with setup instructions
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify that both frontend and backend projects compile without errors
2. Ensure all dependencies are correctly installed
3. Confirm that development servers can be started
4. Validate TypeScript configuration
5. Test environment variable loading

tasks.title: Database Schema Design and Prisma Setup
tasks.description: Set up PostgreSQL database, configure Prisma ORM, and implement the data models as defined in the PRD.
tasks.details:
1. Install PostgreSQL locally or set up a cloud instance
2. Install Prisma in the backend project:
   ```bash
   npm install prisma @prisma/client
   npx prisma init
   ```
3. Configure the database connection in .env
4. Implement the data models in schema.prisma as specified in the PRD:
   - User model with roles
   - Listing model with asset types
   - FinancingTerms model
   - BuyerProfile model
   - Dealroom model
   - Message model
   - Document model for NDAs and confidential files
   - Activity log model for dealroom interactions
5. Create initial migrations:
   ```bash
   npx prisma migrate dev --name init
   ```
6. Generate Prisma client:
   ```bash
   npx prisma generate
   ```
7. Create a database service layer for interacting with the models
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify database connection
2. Test migrations run successfully
3. Validate schema against PRD requirements
4. Create test data and verify CRUD operations
5. Test relationships between models
6. Ensure proper indexing for performance

   ```prisma
     description String

     createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
   }
   ```

tasks.title: Term Sheet Builder with Seller Financing
tasks.description: Implement a term sheet builder that allows sellers to create and buyers to view financing term sheets with interactive amortization previews, including interest rate, duration, down payment, and payment calculations.
tasks.details:
1. Create TermSheet model extending the FinancingTerms model:
   ```typescript
   interface TermSheet extends FinancingTerms {
     id: string;
     listingId: string;
     title: string;
     description?: string;
     isDefault: boolean;
     createdAt: Date;
     updatedAt: Date;
   }
   ```

2. Update Prisma schema to include TermSheet model with appropriate relations to Listing model.

3. Implement term sheet controller with CRUD endpoints:
   - POST /api/listings/:id/term-sheets
   - GET /api/listings/:id/term-sheets
   - GET /api/listings/:id/term-sheets/:sheetId
   - PUT /api/listings/:id/term-sheets/:sheetId
   - DELETE /api/listings/:id/term-sheets/:sheetId

4. Create amortization calculation service:
   ```typescript
   class AmortizationService {
     calculateAmortizationSchedule(principal: number, interestRate: number, termMonths: number, downPayment: number): AmortizationSchedule;
     calculateMonthlyPayment(principal: number, interestRate: number, termMonths: number): number;
     calculateTotalInterest(schedule: AmortizationSchedule): number;
   }
   ```

5. Implement term sheet builder component in React:
   - Form inputs for interest rate, duration, down payment
   - Real-time validation with appropriate constraints
   - Preview of monthly payment calculation
   - Amortization schedule visualization
   - Save/update functionality

6. Create interactive amortization preview component:
   - Monthly payment breakdown
   - Principal vs. interest visualization
   - Payment schedule table with sorting/filtering
   - Export to PDF/CSV functionality

7. Implement seller term sheet management UI:
   - Create multiple term sheet options
   - Set default term sheet
   - Compare different financing scenarios
   - Duplicate and modify existing term sheets

8. Create buyer-facing term sheet viewer:
   - Read-only view of term sheet details
   - Interactive amortization calculator for "what-if" scenarios
   - Highlight key terms and conditions
   - Interest saved compared to standard rates

9. Implement caching for expensive amortization calculations to improve performance.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the AmortizationService:
   - Verify payment calculation accuracy with known examples
   - Test edge cases (zero down payment, short/long terms)
   - Validate amortization schedule generation

2. Test term sheet CRUD operations:
   - Create term sheets with various parameters
   - Verify retrieval of term sheets for a listing
   - Test updating term sheet parameters
   - Verify deletion and proper cleanup

3. Integration test the term sheet builder UI:
   - Test form validation for all inputs
   - Verify real-time calculation updates

4. Test the amortization preview component:

5. End-to-end test the complete term sheet workflow:
   - Create a listing as a seller
   - Add multiple term sheets with different parameters
   - View the listing as a buyer
   - Interact with the term sheet viewer
   - Verify calculations match between builder and viewer

6. Performance test the amortization calculations:

   - Verify caching improves performance for repeated calculations
   - Test with extreme values (very large loans, long terms)

tasks.description: Implement a document generation engine that creates legal documents (NDA, LOI, Term Sheet) from templates with e-signing integration for digital signatures.
tasks.details:
1. Create a DocumentTemplate model and schema:
```typescript
interface DocumentTemplate {
  id: string;
  type: 'NDA' | 'LOI' | 'TERM_SHEET';
  name: string;
  content: string; // HTML/markdown with variable placeholders
  variables: string[]; // List of variable names used in template
  isDefault: boolean;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}
```

2. Implement template storage and management:
   - Create a template repository in the database
   - Implement CRUD operations for templates
   - Add version control for templates with history tracking

3. Create document generation service:
```typescript
class DocumentGenerationService {
  async generateDocument(templateId: string, data: Record<string, any>): Promise<string>;
  async createPDF(htmlContent: string): Promise<Buffer>;
  async storeGeneratedDocument(documentType: string, listingId: string, content: Buffer): Promise<string>;
}
```

4. Implement e-signing integration:
   - Research and select e-signing provider (DocuSign, HelloSign, etc.)
   - Create an adapter interface for e-signing service
   - Implement authentication with the e-signing API
   - Create document signing request flow
   - Handle webhooks for signature status updates

5. Create document endpoints:
   - GET /api/templates (list available templates)
   - GET /api/templates/:id (get specific template)
   - POST /api/templates (create new template - admin only)
   - PUT /api/templates/:id (update template - admin only)
   - POST /api/documents/generate (generate document from template)
   - POST /api/documents/:id/sign (initiate signing process)
   - GET /api/documents/:id/status (check signing status)

6. Implement document versioning:
   - Track document versions with timestamps
   - Store all versions of generated documents
   - Provide access to document history

7. Create frontend components:
   - Template selection interface
   - Document preview component
   - Variable input form
   - E-signing initiation UI
   - Signature status tracking

8. Implement security measures:
   - Ensure documents are only accessible to authorized users
   - Implement encryption for document storage
   - Add audit logging for all document operations

9. Create integration with existing NDA system:
   - Connect to existing NDA gating logic
   - Ensure compatibility with NDA acceptance tracking
   - Extend the NDA model to support the new template system
